```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../../../core/framework/R/framework_init.R")
```

```{r load-gazetteer, include=FALSE}
gaz <- jsonlite::fromJSON("circassia_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

fmt_pop <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) return("-")
  val <- as.numeric(v)
  if (val >= 1000) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.1f", val / 1000)), "k")
  } else {
    as.character(round(val))
  }
}

fmt_yr <- function(y) {
  yi <- as.integer(y)
  if (yi < 0) paste0(abs(yi), "BC") else paste0(yi, "AD")
}

get_span <- function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  if (min(yrs) == max(yrs)) return(fmt_yr(min(yrs)))
  paste0(fmt_yr(min(yrs)), " - ", fmt_yr(max(yrs)))
}

get_pop_yr <- function(s, yr) {
  k <- as.character(as.integer(yr))
  if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  return("-")
}

get_pop_window <- function(s, yr_vec) {
  for (y in yr_vec) {
    k <- as.character(as.integer(y))
    if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  }
  return("-")
}

get_peak_str <- function(s) {
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(s$population))
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  idx <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(fmt_pop(vals[idx]), " (", fmt_yr(yrs[idx]), ")")
}
```

# Introduction

This supplementary report presents the settlement population gazetteer (`circassia_settlements.json`) accompanying the regional literature review of Circassia and Central Ciscaucasia (10000BC - 1900AD). The JSON file follows the `population_Stadester` format, indexing `r length(gaz)` settlements across Krasnodar Krai, the Republic of Adygea, Karachay-Cherkessia, Kabardino-Balkaria, North Ossetia-Alania, and the Caucasian Mineral Waters district by `<Name>-Russia` with alternate and Cyrillic names (`other_names`), decimal coordinates (`coords`), and chronological population estimates (`population`) for inhabited benchmark years.

Prehistoric, Bronze Age, Classical Bosporan, Maeotian, and Alanic estimates are derived from excavated settlement areas and cemetery studies [@formozov1965stone; @korenevskiy2004; @markovin1978dolmens; @reinhold2017; @belinskiy2018; @kuznetsov2017phanagoria; @alekseeva1997anapa; @kuznetsov1992; @kuznetsov1993; @korobov2017]. Early modern and 19th-century figures draw on Genoese and Ottoman port records, Russian diplomatic registers, and accounts of the 1859-1864 expulsion [@kusheva1963; @gardanov1967social; @volkova1974; @khotko2001; @khotko2015zichia; @berger1860expulsion; @kumykov1994], while 1897 and 1900 figures come from the First All-Russian Imperial Census [@kabuzan1996; @troynitskiy1905kuban; @bgeu2007demography; @golovlev2017census].

# Master Settlement Directory

```{r tab-master, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_master <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(gaz, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(gaz, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(gaz, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  Span = vapply(gaz, get_span, character(1)),
  Peak = vapply(gaz, get_peak_str, character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_master,
  list(
    caption = "Master directory of all settlements in circassia_settlements.json (10000BC - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:circassia-master-gazetteer",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "Coords", "Documented Span", "Peak Population", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Prehistoric, Bronze Age, Bosporan, and Maeotian Settlements (10000BC - 400AD)

```{r tab-prehistoric, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pre_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) <= 400), gaz)

df_pre <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(pre_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(pre_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  BC_Eneol = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-8000, -4000, -3500, -3000)), character(1)),
  BC_Dolmen_Koban = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-2500, -2000, -1500, -1000)), character(1)),
  BC500 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, -500), character(1)),
  BC300 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, -300), character(1)),
  AD1 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1), character(1)),
  AD300_400 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(200, 300, 400)), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_pre,
  list(
    caption = "Prehistoric, Bronze Age, Bosporan, and Maeotian settlement populations in Circassia and Central Ciscaucasia (8000BC - 400AD).",
    label = "tab:circassia-prehistoric-classical",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "8000-3000BC", "2500-1000BC", "500BC", "300BC", "1AD", "200-400AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Medieval and Early Modern Settlements (600 - 1700AD)

```{r tab-medieval, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
med_s <- Filter(function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 600 & yrs <= 1700)
}, gaz)

df_med <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(med_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(med_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  AD600_800 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(600, 800)), character(1)),
  AD1000 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1000), character(1)),
  AD1200 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1200), character(1)),
  AD1400 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1350, 1400)), character(1)),
  AD1600 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1600), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Medieval Alanic, Golden Horde, Genoese-Zichian, and early modern settlement populations (600 - 1700AD).",
    label = "tab:circassia-medieval-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "600/800AD", "1000AD", "1200AD", "1350/1400AD", "1600AD", "1700AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Eighteenth and Nineteenth-Century Settlements (1700 - 1900AD)

```{r tab-modern, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
mod_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) >= 1700), gaz)

df_mod <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(mod_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(mod_s, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  AD1800 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1750, 1775, 1780, 1785, 1800, 1803, 1825)), character(1)),
  AD1850 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1850, 1852, 1855, 1859, 1860, 1862, 1863, 1864, 1868)), character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_mod,
  list(
    caption = "Eighteenth and nineteenth-century settlement populations in Circassia and Central Ciscaucasia (1700 - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:circassia-modern-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "1700AD", "1800AD", "1850/1860s", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```
